articles.title: Pakistan carries out airstrikes in Kabul and Afghan provinces after cross-border clashes
articles.summary: Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan's Kabul and other provinces early Friday, responding to a prior cross-border attack by Afghanistan. This reciprocal military action highlights escalating tensions and ongoing border disputes between the two nations. Such developments are crucial for understanding regional security dynamics and international relations.

articles.title: 6 Best Derek Carr Landing Spots as QB Nears NFL Return
articles.summary: NFL player Derek Carr, who retired last season due to a debilitating labral tear in his shoulder, is reportedly serious about a comeback. Lingering pain forced his earlier retirement, but insights from NFL insider Jordan Schultz suggest a strong belief in his potential return to professional football. This development highlights player resilience and recovery in elite sports.

articles.title: Pakistan bombs Kabul after Afghanistan attacks border
articles.summary: Pakistan launched airstrikes on Afghanistan's Kabul and Kandahar cities, following an Afghan forces' attack on Pakistani border troops. The Taliban government justified their actions as retaliation for prior deadly Pakistani airstrikes. This escalating exchange signifies worsening cross-border tensions and military engagements between the two nations, demanding close monitoring for regional security implications.

articles.title: Defence tech Constelli bags $20 million from General Catalyst, others
articles.summary: Defence technology startup Constelli secured $20 million (approx. Rs 180-190 crore) in a funding round led by Silicon Valley's General Catalyst. This investment underscores the increasing focus on indigenous defence innovation within India. For SSB aspirants, this signifies the nation's commitment to strengthening its defence capabilities through private sector advancements and technological self-reliance.

articles.title: J&K to get National Centre of Excellence for winter sports: Mandaviya
articles.summary: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya announced the establishment of a National Centre of Excellence for winter sports in Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir. This strategic initiative aims to bolster India's global presence in winter sports, nurturing talent from the region, and providing state-of-the-art training facilities. It will significantly contribute to national sports development and promote J&K as a premier winter sports hub.

articles.title: Guide: 50 Best Nintendo 3DS Games Of All Time
articles.summary: February 26, 2026, marks the 15th anniversary of the Nintendo 3DS' Japanese debut. As the inaugural system in the evolving '3DS family,' it introduced groundbreaking features and significantly impacted the portable gaming landscape. Its success paved the way for future iterations, solidifying its place as a pivotal console in technology history, enjoyed by millions worldwide.
